name: houdini-test
layout: x fastest, then y (map row, +Y = up in the source image), then z (slice, up); texel (x,y,z) at ((z*dims[1]+y)*dims[0]+x)

boundsMeters.note: source axes: x = map column, y = map row, z = up; origin = corner of source-lattice voxel (0,0,0). VDB mapping: x = hou X, row = hou Z, up = hou Y.

houdini.note: world position (hou axes x, y-up, z, metres after --world-scale) of the crop min corner and of source voxel (0,0,0) corner

sdf.source: exact 3D EDT of (profile > 0) on the cropped lattice, signed (negative inside), surface at half a voxel from the nearest centres
sdf.outsideCrop: treat as far / empty (distance >= margin*voxel from the occupied bounds, except where the crop is clamped to the grid)
